_doc: Glass roles: what each kind of content is for, where it goes and how much of it fits. zone: top-left | top-right | upper | center | lower | ticker | bottom | footer | full. priority: higher wins when two roles share a zone. ttl: auto-clear after (60s, 30m, 2h); null = until cleared. hours: only visible in this window (HH:MM-HH:MM, may cross midnight). limits: per field, in words and lines; a line's length comes from the type size (tokens.resolved.json → measure). A role with its own limits allows only the fields it lists; other fields are dropped; a field set to true is passed through as text. ambient: written by provider scripts, not agents, and left out of docs/agent.md. See docs/content.md.

agenda.purpose: Today's schedule, reminders and plans. Refreshed each morning.

focus.purpose: A standing note the user wants in view (goal, shopping list, countdown).

task.purpose: What Claude is currently doing for the user: title, steps, progress bar.

info.purpose: An answer or summary the user asked Claude to put on the mirror.

notify.purpose: Short transient message: something finished, a reminder fired.

alert.purpose: Needs the user's attention now. Covers the mirror. Clear it once acknowledged.

weather.purpose: Current weather: the temperature as the title, an icon, conditions and a short forecast.

news.purpose: Headlines shown one at a time above the notices; the title is the source.

daily.purpose: Things of the day (a joke, a fact, a quote, a poem…) in the ticker; each item is "Label | text"; written by providers/daily.mjs.

system.purpose: Device stats as a tiny line of icons and figures under the clock, read up close; written by bin/stats.mjs.
